name: holm quest lodge v2 exterior
review_note: Three-mass lodge with the chart turret and porch; laid ridge caps in light stone and iron finials break the gable, turned balusters and rails close the porch edge. Family palette unchanged (29 of 40).
improve: The gable tile pattern still reads as a flat diagonal at distance (the caps help the ridge, not the field); the turret courses remain slab-like; the porch roof is a single plane.
